Heretical Splinter · Small, Quiet, Unforgiven

A splinter who read the Grey Mile as proof of concept rather than warning — decay isn't merely provable, it's directable, and a mortal frame carried far enough into the Litany can point that direction somewhere on purpose. The Foreclosure frames this as mercy: a plague pit collapsed to dust in an afternoon instead of a generation, a dying region's suffering shortened by force. The Long Chapter calls it exactly what the Grey Mile already proved it becomes — an amputation dressed as medicine — and has quietly expelled every Foreclosure member it's ever caught mid-working.
